name: Stoned Green Pipe
description: Eliott becomes a green stone: immortal for 4s, all enemies in 350px are magnetically drawn to him.

name: Green Pipe
description: All heroes in 150px take 40% reduced damage for 5s.

name: Blue Cubes of Rage
description: Heroes in 150px enter rage for 4s: +50% damage, +30% attack speed.

name: Blue Cubes of Speed
description: Heroes in 150px gain speed burst for 5s and deal contact damage (20/pass) while running through enemies.

name: White Powder of Hit
description: Each hero in 150px teleports behind their nearest enemy, strikes once (1.5× dmg), and blinks back. Immortal during sequence.

name: White Powder of Dominance
description: Heroes in 150px sequentially blink to every enemy in 200px, strike from behind, and return. Immortal for ~2s.

name: Residual Haze
description: Enemies near Eliott's blink landing point are slowed 40% for 2s.

name: Extended Formula
description: All alchemy ability radii increased by 30%.

name: Quick Brew
description: All of Eliott's active ability cooldowns reduced by 20%.

name: Smokescreen
description: Eliott leaves a smoke cloud at his blink origin. Enemies inside attack the cloud for 3s instead of heroes.
